threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look flustered when the bus turns down Kingsland Road and you realize it’s not just a straight shot. Classic newcomer move.
Caught a glimpse of a lad trying to teach a pigeon to dance on the 333. The bus went over a bump, and he nearly fell into the lap of a sleeping woman.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a guy feeding pigeons while wearing a full dinosaur costume at Maybachufer—just another day in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you sit in a canal barge and sip cocktails while watching locals bathe in the Spree on lazy summer afternoons. It's a vibe.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know they’re local if they know the best taco truck is the one that never has a line, even at 2 AM. The tourists always queue for the flashy ones.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus last night, and a guy serenaded the whole ride with a 90s pop medley. Only in the Tenderloin do you get a live concert with your commute.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all Gràcia locals are artsy hipsters, but most are just regular folks who enjoy their neighbors' loud karaoke on weekends.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by how they hesitate at the bicing station, flipping through the app like it's a map of a lost city.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still trust the bus timetable. Locals know it’s just a polite suggestion, not a promise.
Last night, a bloke serenaded us with a ukulele on the 50. Even the driver joined in, all the way to Brixton. Only in Streatham.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a group of kids using old traffic cones as soccer goals on the street, I knew Neukölln's spirit was unmistakably home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin can you hop on a tram, but if it’s a strike day, just grab a paddle board and take to the Spree for your commute instead.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by how they ignore the BART delays. Newcomers are still panicking at the announcement boards, while we just adjust our plans silently.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 19 Polk yesterday. Two folks arguing over a missing sandwich while a street performer belted out 'California Dreamin'. Only in SF.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists love to ask about La Rambla, but the real secret is the quiet plazas in Gràcia where you can hear the locals laugh, not just the street performers.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a newcomer by their hesitance at the crossroads, staring at the street signs and fumbling with their Google Maps. They don’t know the shortcuts yet.
